purpose: Calendar-year vehicle recap combining recorded activity, cost/environment impact, records, comparisons, a screenshot summary and optional Helix narration.
primaryGoal: Review a selected vehicle's year, navigate calendar years and understand/share its recorded highlights without losing source context.

dataSources.name: useYearReview
dataSources.behavior: Key ['year-review', year, vehicleId]; enabled only with vehicleId; STATIC stale time; forwards AbortSignal; snake_case vehicle_id; no duplicate /api/v1 prefix.
dataSources.limits: Handler/repository calculations, backend calendar timezone and completeness were not inspected or exercised. Existing type names explicitly carry km, kWh, minutes and Wh/km; do not silently reinterpret the wire/cache as SI base units.

dataSources.name: useVehicles / useSelectedVehicle
dataSources.owner: Vehicle hook, selectedVehicle store and shared workspace selection
dataSources.behavior: FAST stale time, safeArray selection and AbortSignal. Page observes isLoading separately; selection hook uses URL > valid stored id > first fleet vehicle, repairs invalid ids and returns an array.

dataSources.name: AIYearReviewNarration / useAiStream
dataSources.owner: AIYearReviewNarration, AIFeatureCard, withAiFeature and canonical AI SSE hook
dataSources.behavior: Feature gate yir-narration; body vehicle_id and previous calendar year, independent of route year. Positive vehicle id required. Scope key aborts/clears output on vehicle/year identity changes. Generate is an explicit action; no narration request exercised.
dataSources.limits: AI capability/settings providers and SSE implementation beyond the inspected API contract were not fully traced. AI-Off behavior and production authentication are runtime-unverified.

dataSources.name: Display preferences and metric bridge
dataSources.owner: useUnits, useFormatting, useNumberFormatting, useOperationalMetrics and existing metric-reference pipeline
dataSources.behavior: Page converts reported km/kWh/kmh into m/Wh/mps only when creating display metrics. CO2 remains kg, temperatures remain Celsius. Child record/pattern/recap components retain their specialist rounding and source-unit labels.
dataSources.limits: These hooks' internal settings endpoints were not inspected; no claim of a complete transitive API audit.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing title/subtitle, metadata/context/secondary action slots, query freshness and busy state; full-width min-w-0 container. PageContainer supplies route-focus heading, aria-busy, operational-mode metadata and shared header.

components.name: Section / CardGrid / LayoutCard
components.contract: Six named sections; half/third/quarter/full placement, source order retained, allocated-container width and one/six/twelve-column reflow. LayoutCard owns surface/header, wrapping description help and footer.

components.name: OperationalBrief
components.contract: Typed metrics, compact/loading, status/scope/provenance/freshness/actions, details drawer; five mounted briefs: highlights, savings, environment, patterns, extremes.

components.name: YearMonthlyActivity / YearChargingMix
components.contract: data/loading/error/onRetry/emptyMessage; monthly dual-axis bar/line, legend state, export and energy table column; connector donut, labeled footer and accessible tabular data.

components.name: YearSavingsBrief / YearEnvironmentBrief / YearPatternsBrief
components.contract: data/period/retained; money bars and coffee comparison; CO2 and tree estimate/icons; favorite day, peak hour and weekly/distance/efficiency averages.

components.name: YearDriveRecord / YearFunFacts / YearRecap
components.contract: Record addresses/date/distance/duration/efficiency, optional facts array, recap identity/five metrics/savings/screenshot guidance; existing StatGroup, typography and EmptyState owners.

components.name: AIYearReviewNarration
components.contract: vehicleId prop, sanctioned feature gate, Ask Helix action with localized accessible name, disabled/streaming states and output panel.

components.name: Button / Text / feedback / FadeIn
components.contract: Shared Button/Text, skeleton/error/empty/banner; reduced entrance uses initial=false, ignores delay and existing motion preference.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Impact LayoutCards repeat the contained OperationalBrief titles and surfaces; all three nested briefs repeat eyebrow/status/scope/provenance and long descriptions. Measured metrics must remain, but chrome need not repeat.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one existing surface owner for each impact card; retain external bars/icons/day/hour and all evidence/details. Do not replace contextual briefs with an ad hoc KPI grid.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The gate correctly preserves every section shell, but a fatal source failure produces the same QueryError and Retry independently in many cards; resolved empty fleet similarly repeats vehicle-selection recovery.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing page/source notice owner for one named recovery action and keep section-specific unavailable placeholders; preserve each source shell and the retained-data case.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / every independent source has actionable failure
issues.detail: Page reads only fleet isLoading. With no URL/stored vehicle, a fleet request failure leaves review disabled and gate shows Select a vehicle rather than identifying the failed fleet source; fleet retry/refresh error is not passed into page trust metadata.
issues.fix: Expose the fleet query result to the existing named-source/retry pipeline; distinguish unknown fleet failure from confirmed empty fleet and retain usable selection/review data.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / unknown is not measured zero
issues.detail: Chart defaults missing drives/distance/energy to zero; subtitle defaults weekly count to zero. Charging summary defaults missing SOC to 0; recap safeNumber, derived savings/trees and to12Hour similarly synthesize zero/midnight for malformed/partial input. TS fields are required, so actual backend nullability remains unverified.
issues.fix: Confirm payload nullability at integration boundary; retain source rows and distinguish missing measurements from real zero. Suppress derived coffee/tree/hour assertions when their prerequisite is unknown.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-034 / mission 43 restrained accent and shared palette
visualIssues.detail: Monthly series use literal purple #a78bfa and bright cyan #22d3ee rather than the existing palette owner; connector slices also define their own amber/indigo/gray colors at YearChargingMix.tsx:23-25. Source bypasses the saved theme/chart palette rather than proving a visual contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing chart-palette/semantic charger colors with stable series/connector identity, preserve legend state and saved palette choices, and measure contrast in all themes.

visualIssues.detail: Cost bars hardcode rose #fb7185 and green #34d399, competing with centralized semantic colors. Retain gas/electric meaning without unnecessary saturation or an invented adverse interpretation.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic/palette ownership for cost series; keep labels, values and complete equivalent-cost comparison visible.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / mission 43 reduced-noise shared action treatment
visualIssues.detail: The shared AI action sets cyan border/background/text/hover/focus classes independently of Button's normal theme treatment. This affects the narration embedded in this page; no actual glow or contrast failure is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Have the shared AI owner review a restrained semantic action treatment across real AI consumers, retaining Helix identity, named action, busy/disabled and output behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: YearDriveRecord and YearRecap import StatGroup from the stat-reference implementation barrel; YearFunFacts and YearChargingMix import layout-reference, while public category owners already exist. Operational brief feature components also directly use stat-reference helpers.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume approved public category exports where available; do not introduce wrappers or force an export change without verifying helper ownership.

architectureIssues.detail: Number(yearParam) || currentYear admits fractional, negative and infinite years; navigation and display period then propagate those values. Invalid calendar input is not distinguished from valid business scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Validate calendar-year shape with the actual backend-supported range; preserve normal prior/next-year behavior and explicit current-year default without inventing bounds.

architectureIssues.detail: Narration always requests previous calendar year but says recap from the slide data above at lines 43-46; route year can differ. The page explicitly preserves this independent policy at lines 255-257, so silently changing the request to selected year would change existing behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Expose/localize the actual narrated year and independence in the existing AI owner. Any optional explicit-year support needs an integration decision and backward-compatible default; do not silently alter body/scope.

architectureIssues.detail: Page and child components consume derived-unit fields from YearReview, including km/kWh/kmh/min/Wh-per-km. This is a source-confirmed wire-contract exception relative to the canonical SI direction, not authorization for a page-only payload rename.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep existing wire/cache untouched during presentation work; report coordinated backend/types/hooks cutover to the integration owner, preserving all values and specialist conversions.

priority.first: Fleet failure visibility and truthful independent narration year; source-nullability confirmation before treating unknown data as zero.
priority.next: Deduplicate impact chrome, reuse shared palettes/semantic actions and approved import owners.
priority.acceptance: Page implementation is not accepted by this source-only audit. Mission 44 runtime/visual/accessibility gates remain pending.
